commit.message:
fix(engine): let the outer eos win in the from_model_config fallback

The fresh review of 53d58da46 failed it on one finding. When no
generation_config.json exists, the new model_config_eos_ids always read the
text config's eos_token_id, but GenerationConfig.from_model_config lets the
outer config's eos_token_id win and uses the text config only when the outer
one is unset. A nested checkpoint that names one eos at the top and another
inside therefore gained a stop id it did not have before, which is exactly
the change to an already-listing checkpoint that the spec forbids. The loader
now reads the outer value first. A new test (top-level 248046, text_config
248044, no generation_config.json) is red on 53d58da46 and green after; the
Tev1 shape, which names no top-level eos, is unchanged.

The review's second, low finding (the fallback reads only the sibling
tokenizer_config.json, not a --tokenizer-config override) is recorded under
Owed in the spec.

Refs ISSUE-LOCAL-01M3RTGVTN34YQFBR1KZH117XA.
